text_en: Now the main point in what we are saying is this: we have such a high priest, one who is seated at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
text_cn: 我们所论述的要点即是：我们有这样一位大司祭，他已坐在天上“尊威”的宝座右边，

text_en: a minister in the sanctuary and the true tent that the Lord, and not any mortal, has set up.
text_cn: 在圣所，即真会幕里作臣仆；这会幕是上主而不是人所支搭的。

text_en: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices; hence it is necessary for this priest also to have something to offer.
text_cn: 凡大司祭都是为奉献供物和牺牲而立的，因此这一位也必须有所奉献。

text_en: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, since there are priests who offer gifts according to the law.
text_cn: 假使他在地上，他就不必当司祭，因为已有了按法律奉献供物的司祭。

text_en: They offer worship in a sanctuary that is a sketch and shadow of the heavenly one; for Moses, when he was about to erect the tent, was warned, “See that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown you on the mountain. ”
text_cn: 这些人所行的敬礼，只是天上事物的模型与影子，就如梅瑟要制造会幕时，曾获得神示说：“要留心──上主说──应一一按照在山上指示你的式样去做。”

text_en: But Jesus has now obtained a more excellent ministry, and to that degree he is the mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted through better promises.
text_cn: 现今耶稣已得了一个更卓绝的职分，因为他作了一个更好的，并建立在更好的恩许之上的盟约的中保，

text_en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need to look for a second one.
text_cn: 如果那第一个盟约是没有缺点的，那么，为第二个就没有余地了。

text_en: God finds fault with them when he says: “The days are surely coming, says the Lord, when I will establish a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
text_cn: 其实天主却指摘以民说：“看，时日将到──上主说──我必要与以色列家和犹大家订立新约，

text_en: not like the covenant that I made with their ancestors, on the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they did not continue in my covenant, and so I had no concern for them, says the Lord.
text_cn: 不像我昔日握住他们的手，领他们出离埃及时，与他们的祖先所订立的盟约一样，因为他们没有恒心守我的盟约，我也就不照管他们了──上主说。

text_en: This is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their minds, and write them on their hearts, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text_cn: 这是我在那些时日后，与以色列家订立的盟约──上主说──我要将我的法律放在他们的明悟中，写在他们的心头上；我要做他们的天主，他们要做我的人民。

text_en: And they shall not teach one another or say to each other, ‘Know the Lord, ’ for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.
text_cn: 那时，谁也不再教训自己的同乡，谁也不再教训自己的弟兄说：‘你要认识上主！’因为不论大小，人人都必认识我。

text_en: For I will be merciful toward their iniquities, and I will remember their sins no more. ”
text_cn: 因为我要宽恕他们的过犯，不再记忆他们的罪恶。”

text_en: In speaking of “a new covenant, ” he has made the first one obsolete. And what is obsolete and growing old will soon disappear.
text_cn: 一说“新的”，就把先前的，宣布为旧的了；但凡是旧的和老的，都已临近了灭亡。
